### DEBT [standards]: src/interfaces/cli/validation.ts
Reference: CLAUDE.md, "Pull request (PR) audit workflow" - "Use small PRs with one purpose. A PR that changes specs, tests, architecture, runtime code, deployment, and publishing workflows at once is too hard to review and too easy to merge for the wrong reason. Split the work into the smallest reviewable concern that can pass its own local gate."
Evidence: PR 366 stated purpose is the verify/audit evidence contract (title "spec(verification): refine audit evidence contract"; body: "Tightens the audit verification payload contract..."). The diff also introduces an unrelated ValidationCommandHandlers dependency-injection seam and createValidationDomain() factory in src/interfaces/cli/validation.ts, and splits/renames spx/41-validation.enabler/tests/validation.integration.test.ts into three new evidence-typed files plus renames dispatch.property.l2.test.ts to dispatch.property.l1.test.ts under spx/41-validation.enabler and spx/60-surfaces.enabler - none of which touch verify/audit evidence validation.
Required: split the spx/41-validation.enabler and spx/60-surfaces.enabler CLI dependency-injection and test-renaming changes into a separate PR scoped to that concern.

### DEBT [evidence]: spx/41-validation.enabler/21-validation-cli.enabler/tests/dispatch.property.l1.test.ts
Reference: CLAUDE.md, "CLI build and git-hook gotchas" - "L2 CLI tests exercise the built dist/, not source. Any spx/**/tests/*.l2.test.ts shells out to node bin/spx.js -> dist/cli.js."
Evidence: the deleted dispatch.property.l2.test.ts ran a fast-check property over runValidationSubprocess, exhaustively checking the dispatch-safety property against the real CLI subprocess, i.e. the packaged binary process boundary. Its replacement, dispatch.property.l1.test.ts, calls assertUnknownSubcommandProperty, which drives runValidationInProcessWithRecording in testing/harnesses/validation/cli.ts - an in-process program.parseAsync call against a mocked recording domain, never spawning a process. Only one fixed example, assertUnknownSubcommandReportsSanitizedDiagnostic in the retained dispatch.scenario.l2.test.ts, still runs via subprocess; the exhaustive property that used to cover arbitrary unknown-subcommand strings through the actual process boundary no longer does.
Required: restore the dispatch-safety property to run over runValidationSubprocess, or justify in the PR body why in-process coverage is equivalent for this invariant.
